description: [Screener Desk] Whether a ticker is in fAlpha's covered universe, with its sector and latest signal date, or a page through the universe. The other desks return no data for tickers outside it. Available without an account.

index.description: Index membership to filter the listing by, e.g. 'S&P 500'.
index.title: Index

page.description: Page number when listing the universe.
page.title: Page

page_size.description: Rows per page when listing the universe, 1 to 100.
page_size.title: Page Size

sector.description: GICS sector name to filter the listing by.
sector.title: Sector

ticker.description: US-listed equity symbol to check. Without it, the covered universe is listed page by page.
ticker.title: Ticker

name: falpha_screener_desk_coverage
title: Coverage check
